question: What Is Reverse Polarity Protection and How Does It Work?
body_html:
Reverse polarity protection is any circuit that stops current flowing backwards through electronics when supply plus and minus are swapped, protecting ICs and polarised capacitors.

CircuitBest for
Series diodeVery low current, low cost
Series SchottkyLoads of about 2 to 3 A
Shunt diode and fuseNo drop in normal use
P channel MOSFET (high side)Medium and high current
N channel MOSFET (low side)Non automotive low side designs
Ideal diode controllerAutomotive and high current
